name: mndy-mcp
description: Wires the mndy MCP servers into Claude Code and teaches an agent how to use them. Bundles a .mcp.json that registers the GitHub Issues, GA4, Meta Ads, Shopify, and Dapr cache MCP servers over HTTP, plus a skill per server documenting its tools, parameters, and usage. Also ships operational skills: 'brands' for switching which brand/account the analytics tools target per session without restarting servers, and 'meta-token' for verifying and refreshing the Meta access token. Use the mndy MCP servers directly from a shell agent or as part of the full mndy solution.
